title: Invertibility of the inverse-unit clopen transpose
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite field extension E of Q_l. For any clopen immersion j:U to X, integralRingedClopenMap from ringedOpen j to ringedPush j is an isomorphism. This map is explicitly the geometric-adjunction transpose of the inverse actual open unit. The open unit is separately proved invertible using the derived slice presentation; no tensor or system model is assumed.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument, as recorded in lem-sf-integral-canonical-ambient-models.

proof.text: The derived slice presentation identifies actual open extension with a derived equivalence followed by localized extension. Subterminality makes the localized extension fully faithful. Transport full faithfulness and apply the actual open adjunction to prove its unit invertible (integralRingedOpenUnit_isIso).

For arbitrary identified ring sheaves R and S, compare inverse image of R with literal open restriction by uniqueness of left adjoints for the composition/base-change adjunction of sites. Compose that comparison with the inverse coefficient identification to obtain d:S ≅ restriction(R). The adjunction unit equation gives the coefficient counit identity H1; naturality of d and the site triangle identity give H2. Apply pushforwardPushforwardAdj to lift this site adjunction to modules. Uniqueness of left adjoints then identifies the published module pullback with literal restriction along d. Transport the published open adjunction across this identification and apply clopenScalarRestrictionReverseAdjunction; transport back to obtain ordinaryClopenReverse.

Both actual module pullback and actual open extension are additive exact functors. Localize the reverse ordinary adjunction using mapExactDerivedCategory. Uniqueness of right adjoints against the actual geometric derived adjunction gives e:ringedOpen ≅ ringedPush.

The invertible actual open unit gives full faithfulness of ringedOpen. Transport it through e to ringedPush. For every M, the geometric unit at ringedOpen(M) is invertible because e.app M identifies this object with an object in the right adjoint essential image. Expand the specified homEquiv transpose: integralRingedClopenMap.app M is that geometric unit followed by ringedPush of the inverse actual open unit. Both factors are invertible. Componentwise invertibility proves the required natural transformation invertible. This uses no nonempty-object hypothesis and includes the empty and identity immersions.
